name: Grade 8 IIT Summative: Arduino Basics
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 8 Arduino vocabulary table.

words.definition: A board and tool used for physical computing.
words.example: Students used Arduino during the class activity.

words.definition: A kit used to learn Arduino-style electronics.
words.example: Students used Freenove during the class activity.

words.definition: A small computer board that controls electronics.
words.example: Students used microcontroller during the class activity.

words.definition: A path that electricity can follow.
words.example: Students used circuit during the class activity.

words.definition: A board used to build circuits without soldering.
words.example: Students used breadboard during the class activity.

words.definition: A connection point on a board.
words.example: Students used pin during the class activity.

words.definition: Electricity used to run a circuit.
words.example: Students used power during the class activity.

words.definition: The return path for electricity in a circuit.
words.example: Students used ground during the class activity.

words.definition: A part that limits electric current.
words.example: Students used resistor during the class activity.

words.definition: A small light that a program can control.
words.example: Students used LED during the class activity.
